ModMetaData.name: Willing Hands
ModMetaData.author: JalapenoLabs
ModMetaData.description:
The mirror of a slave rebellion: treat a slave well enough, for long enough, and they may choose to stay.
A slave kept in high comfort and good spirits over an extended period builds a quiet sense of belonging. Once settled, there is a small daily chance they send a letter asking to become a full colonist. Accept, and they join freely, even an unwaveringly loyal slave, because a willing choice is not recruitment. Mistreat them and the streak erodes, so the path to a rebellion and the path to a new colonist are two ends of the same lever.
Requires the Ideology DLC.
